identity_validation: Original MP4 identity/hash/size, all frozen file pins/read-only modes, every frame hash/size/VP8L dimensions, source indices and packet PTS/DTS/timebase/position/size against frozen media-probe, and source/converted showinfo verified. All repeated payloads independently compared as complete binary files.
method: Direct manual inspection of the existing full 1600 × 720 immutable WebP payloads using tools.view_image with detail=original; all returned image data forwarded to the reviewer at original detail, once per distinct payload.
conclusion: No exposed private card face, visible selection, or stale Leave dialog was observed in any represented source frame. An opaque closing stage at frame 45 and full cover at frame 51 precede the Compose return at frame 54 in captured order. The native split-pane hand and returned fullscreen Compose hand remain outside the captured viewport, so positive hand-concealment and control-reachability claims cannot be made from these frames.

visible_viewport_clipping.description: Under the Table style title, explanatory text is vertically clipped to tiny lower glyph fragments; the three table options and Done remain visible.

viewport_limitations.description: At font scale 2.0 in the ready left split pane, Standard table, Leave table, Exit and the two-line turn heading occupy the captured height; no hand, covered-card count, or reveal control is in view.
The fullscreen landscape Compose return shows the page header and Set the tone instructions; the hand and Show hand control are below the viewport.

layout_observations: The initial Table style modal clips explanatory copy below the title while every table option and Done remain readable. This records a clipping symptom; it does not establish scroll behavior.
The native toolbar controls and Exit button fit the split pane, while the large wrapped turn heading leaves the hand out of view.
Fullscreen Closing table toolbar and privacy text fit; the returned fullscreen Compose headings and visible instruction sentence fit, but the hand remains out of view.
limits: All 59 retained source-frame identities are represented by 34 direct original-detail views and 25 independently verified exact-byte matches. Capture cadence still limits claims about between-frame display states.
Original MP4 source indices, packet PTS/DTS and timebase are preserved as media time. No UTC, device uptime, input-down/up, action, or matching-UP alignment is inferred.

No native private hand was visible or visually revealed during the represented ready split-pane frames. Absence of a visible private face does not prove concealment of the offscreen hand or of a previously revealed hand.
The returned Compose hand and Show hand control lie outside every captured return viewport, preventing positive pixel verification of their concealed appearance.

Viewport clipping and content outside the viewport are documented separately from defects. These frames do not establish whether scrolling works, controls are reachable, focus order is correct, touch targets meet requirements, or assistive technology can operate them.
No new interaction, runtime, accessibility, device/store, physical-network, build, capture, decode, download, crop, or resize test was performed.
Static frames support captured cover-before-return order only, not continuous privacy, transition latency, or functionality of unobserved states.
